comparison.objective: Release and extract a connector terminal, versus free a screwdriver from a spring clamp and hold it at a marker.
comparison.physical_skill: Precise blade-under-tab insertion with coordinated wire/tool pull, versus clamp actuation, tool clearance, and handoff/positioning.
comparison.success_condition: Terminal removed without connector damage; versus freed tool stably pinched at a target while the clamp base remains fixed and nothing drops.
comparison.reason: Shared release-and-pull primitives are generic; the lock geometry, required coordination, and final state differ materially.
